scope: Two authored policy changes, five successive portable checkpoints, one configured model, full/compacted actions; not universal quality or Codex parity
usageNote: Canonical input_tokens counts uncached input; logicalInput adds cache reads and writes. Model usage and cache mix are measured, not billing guarantees.
limitations: The baseline five-round run used different random corpus identities and occurred earlier; it is not a controlled latency/cost experiment.
Native comparison remains the separately recorded one-checkpoint reference; this run changes only the portable transcript projection.
Near-capacity backreads, more models, Mission recovery and whole-OS crashes remain separate validation boundaries.
